identity.title: Make Runtime v3 Observatory local HTTPS and report bound control address

values.summary: Add fail-closed native TLS, propagate local_addr into readiness and feed data, update local configuration/docs, and prove the integrated HTTPS path.

steps.action: Add and validate TLS init contract
Serve control API with native TLS and actual bound address
Update local init, browser path, and architecture documentation
Run focused validation and exact-revision review

invariants: Discovery derives from the bound listener
CORS grants only exact configured HTTPS origins
risks: Browser trust requires an operator-provisioned localhost certificate
TLS test setup could obscure transport assertions if over-abstracted
stop_conditions: Fix requires a gateway or sidecar
Fix weakens HTTPS or signed-control requirements
